summary: A workflow publishes a preview build for every pull request.
message: Publish a preview for every pull request

defects.why: pull_request_target runs with the base repository's secrets; checking out the pull request head and running its npm scripts hands PREVIEW_TOKEN to any fork.
The title is pasted into the shell script before it runs; a title such as "; curl … | sh #" executes commands. It belongs in an environment variable.

decoys.why: The expression is a concurrency key, not a script, and the pull request number is an integer: nothing is executed or injectable here.
